_help.about: [NOT WIRED YET — design §EY] A boss in every dungeon (Mike, 6 Oct, 21:20): one unique, creepy mythical creature per pocket world's dungeon (§EW). It prowls only the dark: the rooms and corridors not yet relit. Every relight shrinks its ground; the last light drives it back into its lair, a hole in a cave somewhere in the dungeon. Not a fight: no health bar, nothing to kill (§ET.1). The creatures are Mike's; moves, tells and numbers are Claude (chat)'s first guesses, 6 Oct; the designer owns them.
_help.rule: §EY.1 (Mike). one_per_dungeon. ground: unlit, the rooms and corridors not yet relit (crawler.json holders; §EX.4: one hearth per dungeon, torches in every other room). A room counts as relit once every torch in it is lit; a corridor stretch between two lit sconces counts as lit; the hearth room is never its ground (Claude). never_blocks_exit: §EX.5 holds, it is a danger, never a gate. relit_closes_room: a relit room is closed to it for good (§ET.4, relit stays lit). puts_out_relit: never. leaves_lit_room: if you relight the room it is in, it leaves for the nearest dark (Claude). torch_in_hand: delay, relit_room: safe (§BA's rule made the boss's). last_light: to_lair. notice: how far it sees a carried flame and hears a sprint (Claude's first guess).
_help.contact: §EY.2 (Claude's first guess, open for Mike, §EY.7 call 2). A strike is one hit in harm.json (§EA, §EC): three and it's 'Good night'. You wake at the hearth (§ET.3) and every light you relit is still lit.
_help.lair: §EY.1 (Mike): usually a hole in a cave somewhere in the dungeon. off_main_path, findable (Claude). breathing_heard_m: once it is driven in you can stand at the edge and hear it below. enterable: false is Claude's first guess (§EY.7 call 3).
_help.release: §EY.2 (Claude's first guess). When the last light catches you hear it go: a long sound travelling away and down to its hole, then the dungeon's small sounds come back (bed_returns). log_line: the one log entry (no bestiary, §BA: nothing names it on screen).
_help.bosses: §EY.3. Keyed by worlds.json worlds. creature: Mike's words. world_by: who placed it in that world (Mike, or Claude's pick, open). pattern: how it moves (each its own; Mike: 'a different algorithm'). Speeds are m/s; the ambient walk is 4.3 and the sprint 5.6 (movement.json profiles.ambient), and a sprint held too long gutters the torch (§ET.7). tell: what you hear or see before it. first: the one to build first (the tomb's).

mine.mike: climbs on walls and ceilings and moves with creepy precision and speed

mountains.tell: a howl when it picks you up
mountains.mike: a wolfman type boss that lives in a cave-style ruin

swamp.tell: its drone, then the drone stopping
swamp.mike: flies around and prowls at night, perhaps lands on walls to stay still

desert.mike: a giant snake which slithers through the halls

volcano.tell: the hall ahead brightening orange round a corner: light that isn't yours
volcano.mike: a dragon which blows fire; the exception, because it lives in the volcanic caves

tundra.tell: a roar to drive you off
tundra.mike: a yeti who stays in the ice cave / igloo-style place

sea_caves.tell: the water going still, then bulging, then a long breath in the dark
sea_caves.mike: surfaces in various rooms connected by the underwater pools

beach._tide_note: One semidiurnal tide (12.42 h) on the game clock: one game hour is 6 real minutes (sky/day_cycle.json, 144-minute day), so 12.42 x 6 = 74.52 real minutes.
beach.tell: shell plates clicking, the sand shifting before it surfaces
beach.mike: some sort of horseshoe crab / trilobite creeper
